title: bitget
summary: Read selected one-based bit positions from integer-valued input.

gpu_support.notes: Supported gpuArray data input uses exact owner-aware fallback and returns resident output; bit-position controls do not select residency.

description: `B = bitget(A,bit)` returns the value of each selected one-based bit. A scalar input expands, while nonscalar inputs must have exactly matching sizes.
behaviors: All eight native integer classes are supported and the result preserves the data class.
Bit positions must be finite positive integers within the selected storage width.
Only data input selects GPU output ownership; scalar or exact-size bit-position input is a control.
